_about: Copy to build-config.local.json (ignored by Git) and fill in your own paths. Build-Foyer.ps1, Build-Release.ps1 and Build-NativeIdentity.ps1 read it; a parameter of the same name overrides a key. See README.md.
GameRoot: <game folder, the one that holds End>
VanillaRoot: <raw .uasset exports of the game's DataObject tables (FModel), the folder that holds End>
BackdropSource: <raw zen package from retoc>/U_Com_GoldSaucerArena_Bg1.uasset (SHA-256 in data/backdrop-store.json)
BackdropPixels: <1920x1920 BC7 pixels: texconv -f BC7_UNORM -m 1 output with its 148-byte DDS header removed>
